name: M4A1 Carbine
operation: gas (direct impingement), rotating bolt, selective fire
_cyclic_rpm_note: M4A1 full-auto cyclic rate is 700-950 rpm; 800 is the working nominal. 800 rpm = 13.33 rounds/sec.

bolt.note: bolt carrier group, rides rearward on firing/racking; charging_handle travel is 13.59cm (authored to leave ~1cm of bolt in the port) rather than the real 8.9cm, because this model's ejection port is ~11.8cm vs a real ~4.4cm

charging_handle.note: moves with the BCG when racked by hand

trigger.note: whole fire-control group is one mesh; keep the pull subtle

magazine.note: drops straight down out of the well on release

selector.note: safe -> semi is 90 deg about the shaft

case.note: spent case; ejects right on the rearward stroke

round.note: live round; feeds up from the mag on the forward stroke

cycle_of_operations: 1 FIRE: hammer releases, strikes firing pin, round fires
2 UNLOCK: gas drives the carrier back, cam rotates the bolt, unlocking it from the barrel extension
3 EXTRACT: carrier + bolt travel rearward (~8.9 cm); extractor drags the spent case out of the chamber
4 EJECT: case clears the chamber, the ejector kicks it out the port to the RIGHT
5 COCK: carrier compresses the buffer spring at full rear travel and cocks the hammer
6 FEED: buffer spring drives the carrier forward; the bolt face strips the top round from the magazine
7 CHAMBER: the round is guided up and forward into the chamber
8 LOCK: the bolt rotates and locks back into the barrel extension; ready to fire
